observations: Photo 0 shows a grey DIN-rail industrial module with SIEMENS and SITOP branding, terminal blocks, a red LED bar graph, and a DB9 serial port on the lower right.
Photo 1 shows a cardboard box label reading SIEMENS SITOP DC UPS, item 6EP1931-2EC31, input 24V 15A, output 24V 15A load and 0.0-5A battery, date 06.2018, made in Austria.
Photo 2 shows the box sealed with an ORIGINAL PACKAGING sticker.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows SIEMENS SITOP; photo 1 label shows SITOP DC UPS
photo 1 label shows input and output 15A ratings
photo 0 shows a DB9 serial port on the module base

risks.risk: Internal electronics may be dead or damaged
risks.proof: video of the unit powering on with LED status and a multimeter reading on the output terminals

risks.risk: Battery charging or battery output circuit may be faulty
risks.proof: load test on the battery output terminals
risks.if_unproven: as a load-only supply without UPS function

risks.proof: terminal communication test through the DB9 port

risks.risk: Box may be empty or contain a different unit
risks.proof: unboxing video showing the Siemens module inside the box

risks.risk: Connectors or casing may be worn or damaged
risks.proof: close-up photos of the terminal blocks and housing condition

proof_requests: Unboxing video showing the Siemens module inside the box
Video of the unit powering up with all LEDs and a multimeter on the DC output
Close-up photos of the terminal blocks and serial port condition
response.reason: The Siemens model 6EP1931-2EC31 is clearly readable on the box label and matches the device in photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested industrial module.
